dashboard.label: Reading Validation
dashboard.description: Raw 15-minute ZENTRA readings indexed without dashboard math. Compare measurement names, timestamps, values, and units to https://zentracloud.com/#/dashboard_detail/z6-30302. Precipitation on that page is rainfall during each interval, not a daily total — use Rainfall Totals for day/week accumulation.

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` | stats count by device_sn | sort device_sn
`zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats count by measurement | sort measurement

table.title: Measurements present (must match chart titles on the ZENTRA dashboard)

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats latest(units) as units latest(aggregation) as rollup_to_day_or_week latest(sensor_name) as sensor_name count as samples by measurement, measurement_canonical | sort measurement

table.title: 15-minute samples — hover the same timestamp on ZENTRA Cloud; the value and units should match

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" measurement="$measurement$" | eval _time=_time+coalesce(tonumber(tz_offset), 0) | table _time, device_sn, measurement, value, units, aggregation, mrid, sensor_name, error_flag | sort - _time
